final: WITH group_avgs AS (SELECT CASE WHEN ID IS NULL THEN 'NULL_GROUP' ELSE CAST(ID AS TEXT) END as patient_id, AVG(CAST(ANA AS REAL)) as avg_ana FROM Examination WHERE ANA IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CASE WHEN ID IS NULL THEN 'NULL_GROUP' ELSE CAST(ID AS TEXT) END), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(group_avg) as mean_val FROM (SELECT AVG(CAST(ANA AS REAL)) as group_avg FROM Examination WHERE ANA IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CASE WHEN ID IS NULL THEN 'NULL_GROUP' ELSE CAST(ID AS TEXT) END)) SELECT ga.patient_id, ROUND(ga.avg_ana, 2) as average_ANA, ROUND(ga.avg_ana - om.mean_val, 2) as excess FROM group_avgs ga, overall_mean om WHERE ga.avg_ana > om.mean_val ORDER BY excess DESC, CASE WHEN ga.patient_id = 'NULL_GROUP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, ga.patient_id LIMIT 10
